on.offP: Save your progress online so you can keep playing on any device, and play with friends. A grown-up needs to turn this on.
on.privacyLine: No real names or chat. The game’s owner can see player names and play times.
on.gateP: Please ask a grown-up to answer this:
on.gateNo: Not quite. Please ask a grown-up.
on.err: Something went wrong. Please try again.
on.errNet: No internet connection right now. Your game is saved on this device.
on.errPerm: This device can’t open that player. Please sign in again.
on.errPopup: The sign-in window was closed or blocked.
on.nameP: Friends will see this name. Pick a word, an animal and a number.
on.nameTaken: That name is taken. Try another number!
on.cardD: Sign in on any device with your name and 4 pictures
on.cardPicsP: Pick 4 pictures in order. This is the secret password. Remember them!
on.cardHow: On another device: tap “I already play”, pick your name, then tap your pictures.
on.xferD: Get a code or QR to continue somewhere else
on.xferP: On the other device, open the game and tap “I already play” → “Continue code”, or scan the QR code with its camera.
on.haveP: Continue your journey on this device.
on.haveNameD: Use your login card: name + 4 pictures
on.haveCodeD: A code from a device where you are signed in
on.haveGrownD: Sign in with Google to bring your family’s players here
on.wrongPics: Those pictures don’t match. Try again!
on.codeP: Type the 8-letter code from the other device.
on.codeBad: That code doesn’t work. It may have run out – ask for a new one.
on.famP: Signed in as {0}. Pick a player to bring to this device.
on.famNone: No players yet. Start a game and turn on Online in Settings.
on.gotNewer: Loaded your newer save from another device.
on.confP: This player was played on two devices without internet. Which save do you want to keep?
on.confSafe: The other save is kept as a backup.
on.keptHere: Kept the save from this device.
on.stErr: Couldn’t save online – trying again later.
on.stBig: This save is too big to save online.
on.guest: Playing as guest on this device. Ask a grown-up to sign in with Google so your progress is safe.
on.viaCode: Signed in with a continue code.
on.viaCard: Signed in with your login card.
on.signedOut: Not signed in on this device.
on.linkGD: Keep everyone’s progress safe and use it on other devices
on.outMainP: Sign this device out of Online. If no grown-up signed in with Google, you need a login card or continue code to get back in.
on.outKidP: Sign this player out on this device.
on.outKeep: Sign out, keep the game here
on.outRemove: Sign out and remove from this device
on.delP: This deletes {0}’s online save, friends, gifts and play times. The game on this device stays.
on.deleted: Online data deleted. Your game on this device is still here.
on.noFriends: No friends yet. Share your friend code with a friend you know!
on.waitingP: Waiting for them to say yes
on.reqNew: You have a new friend request!
on.myCodeP: Your friend code. Tell it to a friend you know in real life:
on.giftP: Pick a gift for {0}. You can send each friend one gift a day.
on.giftOnce: You already sent this friend a gift today.
on.stkLimit: You sent enough stickers to this friend today.
on.noGroups: You are not in a group yet. A teacher or grown-up can make one.
on.groupNewP: Pick a name for the group. Then share the group code with everyone.
on.challengeP: Answer {0} questions right together this week.
on.busy: Finish what you are doing first.
on.coopNeed: You both need to finish at least one world first.
on.invCoop: {0} wants to fight a boss together!
on.teamWin: Your team beat the boss! Tap a power.
